symbolPolicy: Symbols are globally unique qualified identifiers. Entity IDs identify records; symbols identify typed properties or formula outputs. A symbol may be consumed by many formulas but has exactly one producer in a registry version. No bare single-letter symbols are used.

roundingPolicy.money: Round to 2 decimal places at persisted line-total and report boundaries; retain full precision internally.
roundingPolicy.quantity: Retain 6 decimal places for stored quantities; never round intermediate calculations unless a unit's procurement rule requires whole units.
roundingPolicy.percentile: Use linear interpolation between ordered simulation observations.

formulas.expression: QTY_ASSEMBLY_GROSS = QTY_MEASURED × ASSEMBLY_RESOURCE_COEFFICIENT
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi CSEE assembly definition; measurement evidence is project-specific
validation: Measured and output units must be dimensionally compatible.
Coefficient must be non-negative.

formulas.expression: QTY_PROCUREMENT = QTY_ASSEMBLY_GROSS × (1 + WASTE_RATE), only when waste is not already embedded in the assembly coefficient
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi quantity policy
validation: Waste rate must be between 0 and 1.
If waste is embedded in the coefficient, a second non-zero waste rate is rejected.

formulas.expression: For exclusive: NET=AMOUNT, TAX=NET×RATE, GROSS=NET+TAX. For inclusive: GROSS=AMOUNT, NET=GROSS/(1+RATE), TAX=GROSS−NET. Exempt/zero-rated: TAX=0.
formulas.provenance: Configurable transaction tax policy; subject to qualified Kenyan tax review
validation: Unknown tax status blocks a firm quote.
Recoverable input VAT is excluded from cost basis; non-recoverable tax remains a cost.
Tax status is stored per charge, not inferred globally.

formulas.expression: P_SUPPLIER_LOCAL = P_SUPPLIER_BASE × LOCATION_INDEX_CURRENT / LOCATION_INDEX_BASE, only for a national/base price
formulas.provenance: Verified Wajenzi location-index observations; source and period required
validation: Local supplier quotes must not receive a second location adjustment.
Index values must be positive and share a base period.

formulas.expression: P_LANDED = TAX_NORMALIZED_SUPPLIER_COST + EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT + HANDLING + INSURANCE − DISCOUNT
formulas.provenance: Supplier price snapshot and separately evidenced logistics/handling charges
validation: Delivered-to-site quote has zero additional site-transport charge.
Each charge has its own tax status and recoverability.
Discount cannot reduce landed cost below zero.

formulas.expression: P_FUTURE = P_LANDED × (1 + ESCALATION_RATE_PER_PERIOD)^(MONTHS_TO_NEED / ESCALATION_PERIOD_MONTHS)
formulas.provenance: Approved project escalation assumption or sourced index forecast
validation: Escalation rate must be greater than -1.
No escalation is applied to a fixed-price committed quantity unless contract terms permit it.

formulas.expression: C_MATERIAL = QTY_PROCUREMENT × P_FUTURE
formulas.provenance: Calculated from approved measurement, assembly and price evidence
validation: Quantity and price units must be reciprocal-compatible.
Committed quantities use contractual price exposure, not current market repricing.

formulas.expression: H_WORKER = QTY_WORK / PRODUCTIVITY_PER_WORKER_HOUR
formulas.provenance: Local trade productivity observation or approved estimator assumption
validation: Productivity must be positive and dimensionally compatible.

formulas.expression: C_LABOUR = H_WORKER × WAGE_PER_WORKER_HOUR
formulas.provenance: Verified labour rate or clearly marked mock assumption
validation: Wage basis and productivity basis must use the same worker-hour definition.

formulas.expression: C_EQUIPMENT = OPERATING_HOURS × HOURLY_RATE + MOBILIZATION + FUEL
formulas.provenance: Equipment hire/ownership schedule and operating log assumptions
validation: Fuel or operator cost included in hire rate must not be added again.

formulas.expression: C_LOGISTICS = TRIPS × RATE_PER_TRIP + LOADING + OFFLOADING + WAITING
formulas.provenance: Vehicle capacity, route, load, supplier delivery basis and rate card
validation: Do not charge a transport leg already included in a delivered quote.
Vehicle capacity and load units must be compatible.

formulas.expression: C_DIRECT = C_MATERIAL + C_LABOUR + C_EQUIPMENT + C_SUBCONTRACT + C_LOGISTICS
formulas.provenance: Cost lines allocated once to a primary WJ cost code
validation: Every line has one primary cost owner.
No indirect cost or duplicated delivered transport is included.

formulas.expression: C_INDIRECT = Σ approved project administration + professional fees + statutory approvals + surveys + utilities + insurance
formulas.provenance: Project-specific professional and statutory cost evidence
validation: Preliminaries already assigned to direct systems are excluded.

formulas.expression: C_FINANCE = Σ(period outstanding drawdown balance × period rate) + fees; drawdown balances are approved external inputs and do not depend on the final funding-gap result
formulas.provenance: Financing term sheet, drawdown and repayment schedule
validation: Rate period must match balance period.
Do not include financing costs already embedded in supplier or contractor rates.
Do not derive financing balances from a cashflow output that already includes financing cost; avoid circular finance calculations.

formulas.expression: C_EXPECTED_RISK = Σ(RESIDUAL_PROBABILITY × RESIDUAL_IMPACT), excluding risk transferred or already priced elsewhere
formulas.provenance: Approved project risk register and response status
validation: Probability must be 0..1.
Use residual probability/impact after mitigations where available.
Exclude insured or contractually transferred risk already priced.

formulas.expression: C_CONTINGENCY = ELIGIBLE_COST_BASE × RESIDUAL_CONTINGENCY_RATE
formulas.provenance: Approved project contingency policy
validation: Contingency base is explicit and excludes identified expected-risk allowance, financing and customer margin unless policy says otherwise.

formulas.expression: C_NONRECOVERABLE_INPUT_TAX = Σ tax amount for input charges whose VAT is not recoverable
formulas.provenance: Project tax profile reviewed by qualified tax adviser
validation: Recoverable input VAT is not a cost; tax cash timing may still affect funding.

formulas.expression: C_FORECAST = C_DIRECT + C_INDIRECT + C_FINANCE + C_EXPECTED_RISK + C_CONTINGENCY + C_NONRECOVERABLE_INPUT_TAX + C_OTHER_PROJECT_TAX
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi calculation run and approved formula versions
validation: Customer margin and customer output tax are excluded.
All tax lines are classified and not already embedded in gross cost lines.

formulas.expression: COST_PER_M2 = C_FORECAST / GROSS_FLOOR_AREA_M2
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi project measurement registry; denominator must be identified as gross floor area
validation: Floor area must be greater than zero.
Report the area convention and drawing revision.

formulas.expression: P_CUSTOMER_PRETAX = (pricing_mode = markup ? C_FORECAST × (1 + rate) : C_FORECAST / (1 − rate)) + SERVICE_FEES
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi commercial pricing policy; approved markup or gross-margin mode is selected per quote
validation: Exactly one pricing mode is selected per quote.
Gross margin must be below 100%.
Markup and gross margin are not interchangeable.
Commercial margin and service fees remain outside forecast delivery cost.

formulas.expression: Apply customer tax to the commercial taxable base; inclusive tax is extracted from the gross price and never added a second time.
formulas.provenance: Configured customer transaction tax policy; qualified review required
validation: Unknown status blocks final customer quote.
Customer output tax is not included in forecast delivery cost.

formulas.expression: CUMULATIVE_CASH_BALANCE[t] = OPENING_CASH + Σ(INFLOW[1..t] − OUTFLOW[1..t]); periods must be chronological
formulas.provenance: Approved project schedule, payment milestones and cashflow assumptions
validation: Cashflow periods are ordered and non-overlapping.
Funding requirement is peak deficit, not total project cost.
Cashflow is a funding schedule output and does not feed financing interest unless an independently approved drawdown schedule is supplied.

formulas.expression: FUNDING_REQUIREMENT = max(0, −min_t(CUMULATIVE_CASH_BALANCE[t]))
formulas.provenance: Wajenzi cashflow model; chronological project inflows and outflows
validation: Funding requirement is peak cash deficit, not total forecast cost.
Opening cash and all inflows must be explicit.

formulas.expression: Seeded simulation of cost drivers and residual risk events; report empirical P50/P80/P90
formulas.provenance: Versioned Wajenzi scenario model; distributions approved per project
validation: Persist seed, iteration count, model version and assumptions.
Correlations must be declared; v1.1 independent distributions are an explicit limitation.

nonDoubleCountingRules: Waste is applied exactly once: either inside an assembly coefficient or as a separate waste rate.
A delivered-to-site quote carries no additional site-transport charge.
Every price component has its own tax status and input-VAT recoverability.
Recoverable input VAT is not a project cost; non-recoverable input VAT is.
Location indices apply only to national/base prices, never to an already-local supplier quote.
Escalation applies only to uncommitted or contractually price-exposed quantities.
Expected risk uses residual exposure; contingency covers residual uncertainty and has an explicit eligible base.
Preliminaries assigned to direct systems are not duplicated in indirect overhead.
Equipment fuel/operator costs already included in hire rates are not added again.
Customer margin, service fees and output tax are excluded from forecast delivery cost.
Funding requirement is peak cumulative cash deficit, not total forecast cost.
Approved calculation runs are immutable; corrections create a new run.

unitTemplates.unit-specific: Inherits the dimension and unit code of the associated measurement/resource; never treated as a universal unit.
unitTemplates.KES/unit: Currency per the exact resource unit, e.g. KES_per_m3, KES_per_kg, KES_per_bag_50kg or KES_per_item.
unitTemplates.unit/worker_hr: Resource output per worker-hour; dimension is resolved from the resource unit divided by worker_hr.
unitTemplates.KES[]: An ordered vector of Kenyan-shilling amounts; each element is KES.
unitTemplates.enum|boolean|integer|date[]|distribution: Typed non-dimensional input; not eligible for physical unit conversion.
